standing: TEST FIXTURE for the bounded Stage 2 demonstration, review pathway only. Every value in this file is a TEST INPUT that we chose to exercise the paired width comparison Christian authorized under D5 (reply received 4 November 2026). None is a coach's session, an observation, a recommendation or knowledge. The two deciding circumstances in each scenario are TEST ASSUMPTIONS: the engine never infers them from the dimensions or the player numbers. Each circumstance states the area it describes (appliesTo): the area at the coach's available width, that is, the proposed widened area. Nothing is assumed about the configured area.
dimensions: Length runs along the direction of play; width runs across it. Metres.
